title: The Former Prince Andrew Never Should Have Forwarded Those Emails
text:
Title: The Former Prince Andrew Never Should Have Forwarded Those Emails

At dawn today, that stupid and unethical decision—and many others like it—finally caught up with him. Police arrested Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor on the morning of his 66th birthday, on suspicion of misconduct in public office, and are now searching his homes. Prosecutors have not yet released specific charges, which are thought to relate to Andrew passing on sensitive government information to Epstein. The offense carries a maximum sentence of life imprisonment. His brother, 
King Charles III, was not officially informed in advance, but had signaled that the royal family would cooperate with any police inquiry.
